question: Who shows the supreme divine form to Pārtha?
premises: Hari, great lord of yoga, showed the supreme divine form to Pārtha.
inference: The verse marks the vision as an act of the Lord's yogic power.
uncertainties: Kashmirian recension may vary in wording.
plain_english: Saṃjaya said: having said thus, then, O king, Hari, the great lord of yoga, showed to Pārtha the supreme divine form.
